**ChatGPT changed demand for skills**. We study how the introduction of ChatGPT changed demand for freelancers in substitutable and complementary skills. Demand for substitutable skills, such as writing and translation, decreased by 20-50%. Within complementary skill clusters, the results are mixed: demand for machine learning programming grew by 24%, and demand for AI-powered chatbot development nearly tripled, while demand for novice workers declined in general.
